A provision will be made to exempt supplementary environmental impact assessment after approval of the report if the number of trees to be cut increases by no more than ten percent or decreases.

title: I have prohibited the production, import, sale, distribution, and use of plastic with a thickness of less than 40 microns effective from Mangsir 1, 2082 B.S.
content: (November 17, 2025) to reduce the environmental pollution caused by plastic materials. I have provisioned capital grants to existing industries for replacement of dye to upgrade the quality of the product accordingly.

title: Environmental Protection Programs will be implemented considering melting mountains, shrinking glaciers, and adverse impacts on the overall ecosystem.
content: Nepal's interests will be advocated in international forums in line with the principle of climate justice. Financial access to climate funds will be enhanced. The declaration of the Sagarmatha Sambad will be implemented. Climate adaptation programs will be internalized up to the provincial and local levels in collaboration with the global community.

title: Policy clarity will be established encompassing all aspects of carbon trade.
content: Necessary preparations will be made to sell carbon credits at competitive price in international market through accurate accounting of carbon credits generated from emission reduction efforts.

title: Priority will be given to public health and environment protection by implementing standards to control noise, air, and water pollution.
content: The national air quality standard will be updated and implemented to reduce the effects of rising air pollution.

title: Concessional loans will be provided to the private sector to replace traditional boilers used in factory with electric boilers in order to reduce air pollution in major cities of the country including the Kathmandu Valley.
Awareness campaigns will be conducted at the community level to conserve biodiversity, and prevent and control forest fires.
content: Individuals and communities who provide information about forest fire perpetrators to bring them under the purview of law, and assist in extinguishing forest fires will be rewarded.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 18.61 billion to the Ministry of Forests and Environment. Communication and Digital Infrastructure

title: Citizens' easy access to public information will be ensured.
content: Transparency and accountability will be enhanced by promoting press freedom. The rights to personal freedom and privacy of citizens will be protected.

title: Exploration, research, development, and innovation of the latest technologies developed in the field of communication and information technology will be emphasized.
content: The second version of the Digital Nepal Framework will be formulated. Special programs on digital literacy will be conducted. I have allocated Rs. 740 million for the construction of digital infrastructure and development of the digital ecosystem.

title: Partnerships with the private sector will be done for the construction, operation, and development of data center infrastructure.
content: An Information Technology Park will be established in Kathmandu. Feasibility study will be conducted for establishing a data center in the Mid-Hill region to attract foreign investment in the information technology sector. Land, uninterrupted power supply, and security will be provided to domestic and foreign companies interested in setting up data centers.

title: The Integrated Data Management Center will be upgraded.
content: The capacity of the Disaster Recovery Center in Hetauda will be expanded, and the under-construction Data Center in Kohalpur will be brought into operation.

title: Cloud infrastructure will be upgraded for reliable data security.
content: The foundation will be laid for the establishment of Nepal's satellite in geostationary satellite orbit.

title: An ecosystem for the information technology industry will be developed.
content: Policy arrangements will be made to promote the export of information technology services.

title: An AI Center will be established in collaboration with the private sector for research, application, and expansion of artificial intelligence and machine learning.
content: Facilitation will be done to promote the commercial use of artificial intelligence.

title: Private sector will be encouraged to build indoor and outdoor studios for filming domestic and international movies that reflect Nepal’s art, culture, civilization, and geographical diversity.
The Nepal Telecommunications Authority will be restructured.
content: Digital divide will be reduced by expanding access to information technology. Broadband services will be extended. The access and quality of 4G services will be improved throughout the country. 5G services will be launched in the Kathmandu Valley and major urban areas. I have made arrangements for IMEI registration to prevent illegal import and use of mobile sets.

title: Standards for hardware and software will be developed to ensure uniformity in the information technology infrastructure of public agencies.
content: Arrangements will be made for public agencies to prioritize the use of information technology software developed domestically.

title: The NTV World Channel and PSB Digital Platform will be launched to expand the international reach of public service broadcasting.
content: Legal arrangements will be made to regulate existing OTT services in telecommunications and broadcasting services. Advertising will be standardized, dignified, and organized.

title: The use of social networks and digital platforms will be made dignified and organized.
content: Necessary infrastructure and manpower will be developed to reduce cybersecurity risks. Security advisories will be issued quarterly by assessing cybersecurity risks.

title: The infrastructure for the security printing center will be completed, and printing operations will be commenced.
content: Interconnectivity will be established among postal- related agencies to expand e-commerce and operate logistics services. Post offices will be gradually developed into smart post offices.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 7.72 billion to the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology. Labor, Employment and Social Security

title: Youth skills and competencies will be developed in line with labor market demands to address the problem of unemployment in a sustainable manner.
content: I have allocated Rs. 1.99 billion for the implementation of the National Employment Promotion Program.

title: An Employment Portal will be operated to connect job-seeking skilled individuals to the labor market by updating their information.
content: Employment Fairs will be organized across all provinces in collaboration with the umbrella organizations of the private sector.

title: Labor Destinations will be diversified to make the foreign employment safe, dignified, and productive.
content: Additional bilateral labor agreements will be concluded through labor diplomacy. Additional agreements will be made with the destination countries ensuring workplace safety and service facilities for female migrant workers.

title: Arrangements will be made to provide labor approvals in a simplified manner.
content: Online labor-related services will be delivered from all provinces. A Labor to Entrepreneur Program will be implemented to promote self-employment and increase production by utilizing the skills, capital, and technology of the returnee migrant workers. For this purpose, concessional loans will be made available. 143. "On-the-Job" and "Apprenticeship" programs will be implemented by revising curricula to produce required workforce based on the demand of domestic industries. Technical and vocational training will be conducted in coordination with universities, technical institutes, and vocational training centers to supply skilled manpower required for the industries.

title: Vocational and skill development trainings of less than six months will be conducted through the National Institute of Vocational Training and provinces.
content: Integrated standards will be applied for curricula and practical teaching to ensure the quality of training.

title: Workers' rights and interests will be protected by promoting dignified labor practices, harmonious labor relations, and increased productivity.
All Nepali will be included in a life-cycle-based social security system.
content: Individuals with regular income will be gradually enrolled in the contribution based social security scheme.

title: Scattered social protection programs will be integrated and made just, sustainable, and organized.
content: The National Identity Card will be made gradually mandatory for the implementation of social security programs. Identity cards to senior citizens, persons with disabilities, and incapacitated individuals will be made available through mobile teams.

title: It will be prohibited to top-up funds and duplicate benefits through similar programs from provinces and local levels for the social security programs run by the federal government.
content: An integrated reporting system for social security benefits will be developed. I have allocated Rs. 109 billion for all categories of social security allowances.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 4.28 billion to the Ministry of Labor, Employment and Social Security. Quality Education and Human Capital Development

title: Capable, competent, entrepreneurial, and productive human capital will be developed to enable individuals to shape their own future.
content: The education system will be modernized and made technology-friendly.

title: Incentive programs based on educational results will be implemented in 100 schools, ensuring at least one school in each district.
content: Arrangements will be made for these schools to support other schools in improving their results. For this program, Rs. 2.5 million will be provided to each school.

title: Schools will be re-mapped based on the number of teachers and students, geographic distance and transport facilities.
content: School merger policy will be adopted based on this mapping. I have arranged incentive grants for the merged schools. The positions of teacher will be reviewed. Training will be arranged to enhance teachers' capacities on a periodical basis.

title: Policies will be adopted for the improvement of results and quality of school education by expanding the scope of corporate social responsibility.
content: Lesson learned from successful management practices of community and institutional schools will be applied to other community schools to improve their quality. A teacher bank will be established in cooperation with universities to prevent shortage of teachers in English, Science and Mathematics. Bachelor level graduates will be mobilized as volunteer teachers.

title: Conditional grants in the education sector will gradually be converted into fiscal equalization grants.
content: Arrangements will be made for the conduction and management of secondary education examinations by Provincial level.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 10.19 billion by increasing the budget for the Mid-Day Meal Program provided to students up to grade five. This will benefit 2.8 million students. I have allocated Rs. 1.29 billion to continue free sanitary pad distribution program in schools. This will benefit 1.3 million girl students.

title: Scholarships being provided to students from targeted communities and remote mountainous districts will be continued.
content: Incentive scholarship will be provided to students from the Musahar, Dom, and Chamar communities for higher education in the medical field. I have allocated Rs. 2.44 billion for this scholarship.

title: I have increased the conditional grant being provided by the federal government for the remuneration of early childhood development support worker and school staff working in community schools.
content: For this purpose, I have allocated Rs. 10.16 billion.

title: A teaching-learning system based on Nepali originality will be developed.
content: Virtual teaching system will be used in school education. Digital learning portal will be developed to enhance the quality of education. Hostels will be arranged to help students with disabilities to complete basic-level education. Schools, including private ones, will be effectively monitored by developing national regulatory standard.

title: The subject-specific and methodological uniqueness of traditional education method including Gurukul, Gumba, and Madrasa will be preserved and promoted.

Under the National Education Reform Program, capital grants will be provided for the construction of physical infrastructure of schools with more than 1,500 students in Terai-Madhesh, 1,000 in hills, and 500 in mountains.
content: Ongoing construction of model schools will be completed. I have allocated Rs. 2.72 billion for this program.

title: Higher education will be made research-oriented.
content: Uniformity in the operation of universities will be maintained by formulating an umbrella act related to higher education. Emphasis will be given on reducing the trend of going abroad for studies and on developing human resources based on labor market demands. Departments and faculties of the universities will be restructured.

title: The University Grants Commission will be restructured to develop it as a robust regulatory body for higher education.
content: Grants will be provided to universities based on student numbers, academic quality, and infrastructure needs. Provisions will be made to publish academic calendars before the academic year begins, monitor their implementation, and withhold grants from universities that fail to comply the calendar.

title: The infrastructure development and human resource management of the Madan Bhandari University of Science and Technology will be carried forward.
content: The Shahid Dashrathchand Health Science University will be brought into operation. Infrastructure of the Vidushi Yogmaya Himalayan Ayurved University will be constructed.

title: Policy will be adopted to attract foreign students as well to universities.
content: Foreign students will be provided free visas for the duration of the academic calendar. Arrangement for multiple-entry visas will be made for their guardians.

title: Scholarships will be provided to produce the necessary human resources for the public health system, based on subject and number.
content: As per the recommendations of the High- Level Economic Reform Advisory Commission, scholarships provided in medical education will be targeted toward poor, meritorious, and students from extremely remote areas.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 560 million to initiate the construction of the infrastructure of medical colleges under construction and proposed in Bardibas, Butwal, Surkhet, and Dadeldhura.

title: The study quotas will be increased by reviewing existing standards to prevent shortages of human resources in technical fields such as medicine, engineering, information technology, and nursing.
Students who have completed school education will be encouraged to enroll in technical and vocational education or university education based on their results.
content: Youths who are unable to get higher education will be made entrepreneurial through skill-based training. Training of more than six months will be provided to 26,900 youths through the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training in the upcoming year.

title: One technical school in each province will be selected and upgraded to a model educational institution.
content: The provision will be made for the students from technical streams of general schools to be allowed to use the infrastructure and facilities of these educational institutions for skill development.

title: Interns will be mobilized in public institutions based on the nature of service.
content: Padhdai Kamaudai (Work while Studying) program will be implemented with 20 hours of work per week with a minimum wage to promote entrepreneurship-friendly education.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 211.17 billion to the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology. Disease-free Nepal: Healthy Nepali 172. ‘Nirogi Nepal’ (Disease-free Nepal) campaign will be launched to develop lifestyles with healthy diet, yoga, meditation, exercise, and positive thinking. Free, accessible, and quality basic health services will be provided to the general citizens. Investment will be increased in competent manpower, modern equipment, and infrastructure to expand the scope of specialized health services.

title: The Health Insurance Program will be restructured.
content: The legal provisions related to this program will be effectively implemented and its scope will be expanded. The benefit package for insured individuals will be increased gradually. The Social Health Security Program will be integrated into the health insurance. Insured individuals will be given the option to choose from different policies. Duplication will be eliminated, leakages will be controlled, and institutional governance will be maintained to prevent misuse of insurance facilities. Insurance benefits will be continued for senior citizens, persons with disabilities, Dalits, the ultra-poor, and minority communities. I have allocated Rs. 10 billion for the Health Insurance Program. Additionally, I have made arrangements to verify and settle the remaining claim payments through third-party assessment within this fiscal year.

title: Specialized services equipped with skilled doctors and modern equipment will be expanded for the diagnosis and treatment of non-communicable diseases such as high blood pressure, heart disease, diabetes, kidney disease, liver disease, and cancer.
content: Treatment services for heart disease and cancer will be expanded in seven provinces. Arrangements will be made to conduct intensive screening for non-communicable diseases in the month of Falgun.

title: Supply of medicines currently being provided free of charge from primary health service centers and primary hospitals will be ensured.
content: Arrangements will be made to record and publish the data of the distributed medicines through website. I have allocated Rs. 2.06 billion for this purpose.

title: I have allocated necessary budget to enhance preparedness and response to health emergencies arising from infectious diseases and pandemics, and to control vector-
content: borne diseases such as dengue. Latest technologies will be adopted for the diagnosis and treatment of sickle cell anemia, a serious health issue in the Tharu community.

title: Specialized burn treatment units will be operated in one government hospital in all provinces to provide quality burn treatment services within the country.
content: An advanced intensive care unit for burn treatment will be expanded in the Bir Hospital.

title: I have made arrangements for capital grants to improve the services and quality of the Kirtipur Burn Hospital, Dhulikhel Hospital, Kathmandu Institute of Child Health, Tilganga Eye Hospital, and Rana Ambika Eye Hospital.
The ongoing construction of primary hospitals will be completed.
content: Construction completed hospitals will be operated in collaboration with local levels and communities. I have allocated Rs. 11.24 billion for this purpose.

title: Telemedicine and digital health services will be expanded to ensure easy access to health services for all citizens.
content: Robotic technology and artificial intelligence will be used for ultra-modern health services.

title: I have allocated budget for construction of infrastructure, equipment, and human resource management to provide international-standard medical education and ultra-
content: modern health services at the Bir Hospital. The Kanti Children's Hospital will be developed as a center of excellence for child health services.

title: The free testing program for cervical and breast cancer, as well as uterine prolapse, will be continued.
content: I have allocated funds for the HPV vaccine targeted at young girls and free cancer treatment for children under the age of fourteen years.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 13.82 billion to operate the Safe Motherhood Program, the Golden Thousand Days Program, and the Social Health Security Program for indigent citizens to protect the lives of pregnant women, postpartum women, and newborns. Services for the identification, treatment, and rehabilitation for the children with autism and intellectual disabilities will be initiated in all provinces.

title: Mental health problems will be eradicated through psychosocial counseling and awareness programs.
content: The capacity of the Mental Hospital in Lagankhel will be expanded. National Neuroscience Center will be established in the central hospital located in the Kathmandu Valley to provide quality treatment for brain, spinal cord, and neurological disorders.

title: The National Public Health Laboratory in Teku will be upgraded to an international-
content: standard laboratory to make it capable of testing all types of samples by developing infrastructure, providing equipment, and managing human resources. I believe this will eliminate the need to send samples abroad for testing.

title: Alternative treatment methods such as Ayurveda, naturopathy, homeopathy, acupuncture, Amchi will be promoted.
content: The production capacity of Singhadurbar Vaidyakhana will be expanded. A National Ayurveda Panchakarma Yoga Service Center will be brought into operation. Nagarik Arogya Karyakram (Citizen Wellness Program) will be expanded to all local levels.

title: Regulatory capacity will be strengthened to make quality medicines available at affordable prices.
content: The quality of all types of medicines will be tested by expanding the capacity of National Drug Laboratory. Increasing the domestic production of essential medicines will be facilitated.

title: Benefits of the demographic dividend will be utilized for development and prosperity through the implementation of the National Population Policy.
content: Production and employment opportunities will be created in the rural economy to change the situation of ‘vikas ukalo chadne, manchhe oralo jharne’ (development moving uphill, people moving downhill). Policies will be adopted to manage migration and to ensure that the population growth rate does not fall below the replacement level.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 95.81 billion to the Ministry of Health and Population. Youth and Sports

title: Youth will be inspired to engage in nation-building with self-discipline and a spirit of service.
content: Youth contribution in the country's economic and social development, and service delivery will be enhanced.

title: National volunteer identity cards will be provided to the youths above the age of 16 years based on certain criteria in coordination with the National Youth Council.
content: They will be mobilized in education, health, social awareness, environment protection, and rescue, relief and rehabilitation during disasters by making them competent through training and instruction.

title: Collateral-free concessional loans ranging from Rs.
content: 200 thousand to Rs. 2 million at three percent interest rate will be provided to educated youth based on their educational qualifications, business registration, skill test certificates, and project proposals to make them entrepreneurial and self-employed.

title: Investment will be gradually increased to construct sports infrastructure and enhance players’ professionalism.
content: Regular training and competitions will be organized to foster a high morale of “Ma Jitna Sakchhu” (I can win) in players.

title: Private sector will be attracted to invest in sports infrastructure to produce national and international level players, and promote sports competitions.
content: Access to roads, drinking water, and electricity will be ensured for such sports infrastructure.

title: A modern international-standard stadium capable of hosting all type of sports competition will be constructed in Damak, Jhapa.
content: High-altitude sports stadiums will be constructed in Solukhumbu, Mustang, and Jumla to diversify sports genres and promote sports tourism.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 420 million for the construction of Mulpani Cricket Stadium in Kathmandu, Girija Prasad Koirala Stadium in Morang, Fapla Cricket Stadium in Kailali, and Siddhartha Cricket Stadium in Rupandehi. I have allocated Rs. 400 million to upgrade cricket stadium in Kirtipur. I have provisioned conditional grant to purchase the created assets of the Gautam Buddha Cricket Stadium in Chitwan based on the evaluation to be conducted by the Tribhuvan University Institute of Engineering. I have significantly increased the budget to build sports infrastructure.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 540 million to organize the Tenth National Sports Competition in Birendranagar, Surkhet. I have allocated necessary budget to operationalize the National Anti-Doping Agency.

title: Nepali athletes who win medals in international sports competitions will be rewarded.
content: Educational scholarships will be provided to these athletes and their children. I have continued the incentive allowances being provided to athletes and coaches.

title: Women targeted training and practice programs will be conducted to increase women's participation in sports.
content: Special arrangements of awards will be made for outstanding female athletes.

title: I have allocated budget to operate sports academies in at least three schools in each province.
content: Children and youth will be mobilized in social service and rescue activities by making them dutiful, disciplined, self-reliant, virtuous, and capable through scouts.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 6.08 billion to the Ministry of Youth and Sports. Women, Children, and Senior Citizens

title: The role of women in all sectors of national life will be made effective.
content: Emphasis will be given to ending gender discrimination, developing leadership capacity, and empowerment. Policy and structural reforms will be made to ensure 33 percent women participation in the executive level of the public sector.

title: Effective programs will be conducted to ensure economic, social, and cultural rights to equality by ending all types of discrimination and oppression against women.
content: The confidence and self-respect in women will be enhanced by improving the educational and economic status of women.

title: Nutrition programs targeted to pregnant and postpartum women, and children will be conducted.
content: I have allocated necessary fund for the National Women Upliftment Program to continue the work of free airlift for pregnant and postpartum women in remote areas whose lives are at risk.

title: Employment and self-employment opportunities will be increased through promotion of women-targeted entrepreneurship.
content: Arrangements will be made to waive fees for registering or renewing industries, businesses, or companies in the name of women. Capacity development programs will be conducted to link the labor and skills of housewives with small and cottage enterprises.

title: The opportunities for education, health, nutrition, recreation, and social protection will be made available to guarantee constitutionally provided child rights and comprehensive development of children.
content: Partnership with local levels will be made to build children’s parks.

title: The street-children-free national campaign will be continued.
content: Protection, family reunion, social rehabilitation, and alternative care arrangements will be made for abandoned, neglected, and parentless children. Capacity of the juvenile correction homes will be expanded. Psychosocial and career counseling will be made available to children involved in delinquency to bring them back to the right path. Child helpline service will be linked with the Nagarik (citizen) app.

title: The knowledge, skills, and experience of senior citizens will be passed down through generations.
content: Arrangements will be made for social security and health treatment to the senior citizens. Collaboration will be done with philanthropic organizations engaged in the street-human-free campaign for those in need.

title: The identity card distribution system will be organized by updating the standards for identification and classification of persons with disabilities.
content: Public services will be made disable-friendly. Community-based rehabilitation services will be expanded for helpless, incapacitated, and completely disabled persons.

title: Programs for information gathering, monitoring, and awareness will be implemented to control the risk of human trafficking.
content: Zero-tolerance policy will be adopted against all types of violence and oppression against women, including acid attacks.

title: Construction work of the service center for women, children, and senior citizens will be completed.
content: Rehabilitation centers for women victims of violence will be established in Madhesh, Sudurpaschim, and the Kathmandu Valley. I have allocated Rs. 620 million for this purpose.

title: A national campaign against untouchability and discrimination will be conducted to build an equitable, civilized, and cultured society.
content: Special programs of social integration and cohesion will be conducted for this purpose. National day for the elimination of caste-based discrimination and untouchability will be celebrated on 21st Jestha every year.

title: Programs for family and social awareness will be conducted to end malpractices such as child labor, gender violence, sexual abuse, witchcraft accusations, chhaupadi (menstrual exile), menstruation discrimination, child marriage.
content: Those involved in such crimes will be punished according to law.

title: The Social Welfare Council and National Child Rights Council will be restructured.
content: Non-governmental organizations will be mobilized according to national priorities and local needs. The recording, monitoring, and evaluation system of programs conducted by national and international non-governmental organizations will be made effective.

title: Programs on empowerment, awareness, and social cohesion will be conducted for enabling gender and sexual minorities to live a dignified life.
I have allocated Rs.
content: 2.08 billion to the Ministry of Women, Children and Senior Citizens. Clean Energy and Irrigation

title: Sustainable utilization of water resources, research and development in the energy sector will be emphasized to contribute to the prosperity of the country.
content: Water resources will be optimally utilized, conserved, and regulated in accordance with the river basin master plan. Water level measurement and digitization will be carried out for the utilization and management of groundwater resources.

title: Hydropower generation, transmission, and distribution system will be managed.
content: Power generation will be diversified for energy security. High priority will be given to the construction of large reservoir-based projects. Private sector investment will be encouraged in hydropower survey, generation, transmission, and distribution.

title: Micro and small hydropower, solar and wind energy will be developed for energy mix.
content: Different tariffs will be set based on energy demand and consumption time for industrial and household consumers.

title: Domestic energy consumption will be increased by means of reliable electricity supply.
content: The remaining works of rural electrification will be completed within upcoming two years.

title: Diplomatic initiatives will be taken with neighboring and other potential countries to ensure electricity export on the basis of increase in electricity production.
content: Nepal's presence in the regional electricity market will be strengthened.

title: Feasibility study of green hydrogen will be conducted in cooperation with the universities and private sector.
content: Domestic and foreign private investment will be attracted for the production of green hydrogen.

title: Arrangement of power purchase agreement equivalent to reservoir-based projects will be made for solar and wind energy stored in batteries and connected to the national system.
Land acquisition for the reservoir-based Dudhkoshi Hydropower Project of 670 MW will be completed and construction will be commenced.
content: Study completed Lower Seti Project, located in Tanahun, will be constructed with government investment. The Budhigandaki Project will be constructed under Public-Private Partnership. The government’s investment in this project will be converted into shares. Investment models will be finalized and construction will be commenced for projects including Upper Arun, Kimathanka Arun, Nalgad, Phukot Karnali, Uttarganga, Tamor, Mugu Karnali, Sunkoshi-3.

title: Construction of the Tamakoshi-5 project will be accelerated.
content: Construction of the Chainpur Seti of 210 MW and Jagadulla Hydropower Project of 106 MW will be commenced within the upcoming fiscal year. Detailed engineering design of the Karnali Chisapani Multipurpose Project will be completed and the investment model will be finalized.

title: Projects with high return potential will be constructed under the management of the Nepal Electricity Authority and co-investment of interested Nepali citizens under the People’s Hydropower Program.
content: The detailed project reports of the Pancheshwar Multipurpose Project will be completed and initiatives will be taken to move forward the construction work.

title: Substations and transmission lines will be constructed in alignment with the completion schedule of hydropower projects.
content: A policy to sign power purchase agreements will be adopted that ensures a balance between electricity generation and consumption. Power purchase agreements will be made under the take and pay basis for run-of-river projects.

title: Industries that build their own distribution lines from the national transmission system to their premises will be permitted to levy wheeling charges.
content: The process of laying electricity distribution lines underground in densely populated urban areas will be accelerated.

title: Construction of national and cross-border transmission lines of Khimti-Bahrabise-
content: Lapsiphedi, New Butwal-Gorakhpur, Dododhara-Bareilly of 400 KV and Chilime- Kerung of 220 KV will be advanced. Construction will be commenced after the completion of study for Inaruwa-Purnia of 400 KV and Chameliya-Jauljibi of 220 KV transmission lines. Construction of Kohalpur-Surkhet-Jumla transmission line of 132 KV will be completed within two years for regular power supply in Karnali Province. Additional cross-border transmission lines will be constructed based on the energy export potential. I have allocated Rs.13.18 billion for transmission line expansion and distribution projects.

title: Uninterrupted, adequate, and reliable electricity supply will be made available to the areas with high electricity demand including industrial areas.
content: I have made arrangement to provide additional rebate on tariff rates for manufacturing industries consuming electricity more than a fixed unit during low-demand periods.

title: Use of household electrical appliances including electric stoves will be promoted to increase the consumption of clean and renewable energy by replacing traditional energy and LPG gas.
content: Complete wiring pilot project will be conducted in seven cities of seven provinces to fulfill household energy needs through electric means.

title: Arrangements will be made for automatic transmission of the information of power supply interruption to distribution centers and immediate maintenance.
content: Electricity leakage will be reduced.

title: Arrangement will be made to deposit the sales revenue of the electricity generated from multipurpose projects constructed with the Government of Nepal’s investment into the government’s consolidated fund.
content: Revenue from the sales of electricity generated by Rani Jamara-Kulariya Project and to-be-generated by Bheri-Babai and Sunkoshi-Marin Projects will be deposited into the consolidated fund of the Government of Nepal.

title: Carbon emission will be reduced by increasing generation and consumption of alternative energy.
content: Private sector investment will be attracted in solar, bio and wind energy. I have allocated Rs. 2.33 billion for alternative energy.

title: Irrigation infrastructure will be developed to expand irrigated area on arable land.
content: Multipurpose projects will be so constructed that headworks, canal, tunnel, powerhouse, and distribution system are completed at the same time.

title: Babai, Rani Jamara Kulariya, Mahakali, Praganna-Badkapath irrigation projects will be completed within upcoming three years.
content: Construction of Sikta and Mega Dang Valley Irrigation Project will be accelerated. I have allocated Rs.8.5 billion for this purpose. I have allocated Rs. 2.07 billion to complete the construction of headworks and powerhouse of Bheri-Babai Diversion Project within two years.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 1. 82 billion for maintenance, restoration, and management reform of irrigation systems including Sunsari-Morang, Chandra Canal, Kamala, Narayani, Gandak, Rajapur.

title: Construction of the Sunkoshi-Marin Diversion Project will be accelerated.
content: Irrigation facility will be expanded to 122 thousand hectares of arable land in Bara, Rautahat, Sarlahi, Mahottari and Dhanusha districts by upgrading the Bagmati Irrigation Project and using the additional water available from the Sunkoshi-Marin Diversion Project. I have allocated Rs. 2.73 billion for this purpose.

title: Reliable irrigation facilities will be made available to 468 thousand hectares of cultivable terraces in hilly and mountainous regions by expanding lift irrigation facilities within upcoming five years.
content: Ongoing projects will be completed to provide groundwater irrigation facilities in Terai and Inner Madhesh. I have allocated Rs. 3.31 billion for this purpose.

title: Construction of the Naumure Multipurpose Project will be commenced by ensuring investment.
content: Detailed study will be completed and construction modality will be finalized for the Kaligandaki–Tinau River Diversion Project. Study and preparatory works will be accelerated for Tamor-Chisyang, Sunkoshi-Tawa, Trishuli-Lothar, Madi- Dang, and Gwar Khola multipurpose projects. I have allocated Rs. 370 million for this purpose.

title: Quality and reliable weather information system will be developed.
content: Appropriate technology and early warning systems will be adopted for the management of water- induced disasters.

title: River control programs will be conducted in major rivers such as Mahakali, Karnali, Narayani, Koshi to manage risks of riverbank erosion, inundation and landslides.
content: Reconstruction of irrigation systems in the areas affected by monsoon-related disasters and earthquakes will be accelerated. I have allocated Rs. 5.59 billion for this purpose.

title: An additional 942 MW of electricity will be generated from the completed hydropower projects in fiscal year 2025/26, increasing total installed capacity to 4,800 MW.
content: Similarly, double circuit national transmission line of 732 km will be constructed.

title: Irrigation facilities will be extended to additional 14 thousand hectares of land in fiscal year 2025/26.
content: Embankment construction of 63 km and land reclamation of 270 hectares from rivers will be carried out in river control.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 86.01 billion to the Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation. Sustainable, Quality and Safe Infrastructure

title: Modern and high-quality infrastructure will be constructed to accelerate the economic and social development of the country.
content: Sustainable road network will be expanded for safe and reliable mobility. The construction of modern infrastructure such as expressways, underpasses, and overpasses will be expedited. National highways will be gradually upgraded into speedy and safer roads ranging from two to eight lanes based on need. Regular maintenance of roads will be carried out to ensure sustainable operation.

title: Policy will be adopted to open new road tracks only in locations deemed suitable from economic, technical, and environmental perspectives.
content: The use of tunnel technology will be expanded in road infrastructure construction. I have allocated Rs. 2.60 billion to complete the construction of the Nagdhunga and Siddhababa tunnels in the upcoming fiscal year. Wildlife-friendly infrastructure such as overpasses and underpasses will be constructed in forest and national park areas.

title: Cement, rods, gravel, and sand will be used for blacktopping including RCC casting for quality and sustainable road construction in urban and geologically sensitive areas.
content: I believe this will increase the consumption of domestic construction materials and make the road infrastructure more durable.

title: I have allocated the necessary funds for the feasibility study of podway based on new technology as an alternative to the currently closed Kathmandu-Hetauda Ropeway.
content: Cable car operations will be encouraged in hilly and mountainous areas. The private sector will be facilitated to build the Birethanti-Muktinath cable car.

title: Within the upcoming two years, 422 kilometers of the East-West Highway, covering the Kakadbhitta-Laukahi, Kamala-Kanchanpur, Kamala-Bagmati, Bagmati-Pathlaiya, Butwal-Narayangadh, and Butwal-Gorusinge section will be upgraded to four lanes.
content: The upgrading work of the Gaddachowki-Attariya section of the East-West Highway will be commenced in the upcoming fiscal year. I have allocated Rs. 21.19 billion for this purpose.

title: The upgrading of Siddhartha Highway to a dedicated double lane will be initiated in the fiscal year 2025/26, considering its high potential for tourism promotion and economic activity expansion.
The existing alignment of the Pushpalal Mid-Hill Highway will be revised to reduce travel time, cost, distance, and accidents.
content: Preparations will be made to upgrade this highway to a dedicated double lane with tunnel and viaduct technology. I have allocated Rs. 3.94 billion for this purpose.

title: The construction of the Postal Highway will be completed within two years to strengthen the economic development and connectivity of the Terai-Madhesh region.
content: I have allocated Rs. 3.56 billion for this program.

title: The construction of the Kathmandu-Terai Madhesh Fast Track will be completed by the fiscal year 2026/27.
content: The construction of subbase in 37 km road, 4 km of tunnels, and 60 bridges will be completed in the upcoming year. I have allocated Rs. 24.49 billion for this purpose.

title: The expansion of the Naubise-Mugling section of the Prithvi Highway into a dedicated double lane will be expedited.
content: The upgradation of the Aanbukhaireni-Pokhara section to four lanes will be completed in the upcoming fiscal year. I have allocated Rs. 8.52 billion for this purpose.

title: Four-lane commercial routes connecting the East-West Highway to the district headquarters of the Terai-Madhesh region and border checkpoints, including Rani-
content: Itahari, Birgunj-Pathlaiya, Belahiya-Butwal, Mohanapul-Attariya will be completed.

title: The construction and upgrading of the Karnali, Kaligandaki, and Koshi Corridors will be expedited.
content: The Hilsa-Simikot and Khulalu-Piluchaur-Tumcha sections of the Karnali Corridor will be upgraded in the upcoming fiscal year. I have allocated Rs.1.27 billion for the Karnali Corridor.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 2.33 billion for upgrading the Kaligandaki Corridor and the Khandbari-Dobhan section of the Koshi Corridor. I have allocated budget to open the Chatara-Leguwaghat Road track under the Arun Corridor.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 2.51 billion for the construction of the Madan Bhandari Highway which connects settlements and markets from Bahundangi in Jhapa to Rupal in Dadeldhura.

title: A detailed study of the Attariya-Khodpe-Darchula road section will be completed, and work to upgrade it to a dedicated double lane will be commenced.
content: I have allocated the necessary budget for upgrading the Brahmadev-Jhulaghat-Tusarpani section and opening the track for the Tusarpani-Tinker section under the Mahakali Corridor.

title: I have allocated budget for upgrading the Surkhet-Khulalu-Kalikot-Jumla road and the Surkhet-Mahavulek-Nagma-Gamgadhi road under the Karnali Highway.
content: The Talcha- Rara road will be blacktopped. I have allocated Rs. 2.56 billion for upgrading the Galchhi-Rasuwagadhi road.

title: I have allocated necessary funds to upgrade strategically and commercially important roads such as Tamor Corridor, Damak-Chisapani road, Bheri Corridor, Dumre-
content: Beshishahar-Chame road, Kakrahwa-Saljhandi-Sandhikharka-Dhorpatan road, Shahid Marg, Ratna Highway, Rapti Highway, Khutiya-Dipayal. I have allocated Rs. 1.24 billon to continue the upgrading work of the Kalanki-Basundhara-Dhovikhola section of the Kathmandu Ring Road.

title: I have allocated necessary budget to reconstruct roads damaged by disasters, including the BP Highway, Araniko Highway, Kanti Highway, Mechi Highway.
content: I have allocated Rs. 3.18 billion for the construction of road bridges on national highways.

title: Projects under the ongoing alternative auxiliary highways and the Electoral Constituency Strategic Road Program will be completed within the upcoming fiscal year, and the resulting liabilities will be settled.
content: For this purpose, I have allocated Rs. 21.08 billion.

title: Roads will be classified based on geographic location, population, traffic volume, and lanes and length.
content: Vehicle standards will be formulated to reduce road crashes. Traffic signs and street lighting will be installed in major cities to manage traffic flow.

title: Modern technology will be used to measure vehicle pollution.
content: Additional 100 electric buses will be provided to Sajha Yatayat to make the traffic system in the Kathmandu Valley environment friendly. Operation of mass transport systems will be encouraged to manage passenger volume on public transport in urban areas.

title: Refresh centers will be operated to reduce road crashes.
content: Arrangements will be made to ensure all types of vehicles undergo regular fitness tests. Third-party insurance will be gradually made time-relevant.

title: The use of electric vehicles will be encouraged to make it reliable, high quality, and sustainable.
content: The private sector will be attracted to invest in building charging stations and workshops.

title: Private investment will be attracted to operate smart public transport in the major cities including the Kathmandu Valley.
content: Public Transport Authority will be established. Arrangements will be made for the issuance of driver’s licenses at the provincial level.

title: Feasibility study will be conducted to explore options such as metro rail and monorail to modernize and systematize public transportation in the Kathmandu Valley.

The provision of restricting province and local levels from levying additional fees and charges on vehicles, means of transportation, and heavy equipment imported temporarily from international border points, after collecting duties at customs points according to prevailing laws, will be implemented effectively.
Resource management and other preparations will be advanced for the construction of study completed tunnel projects on Dumkibas-Bardaghat, Khurkot-Chiyabari, Babai-
content: Chhinchu, Majhimtar-Shaktikhor, Hemja-Nayapul, Kulekhani-Bhimfedi, and Dharan- Leuti. Feasibility studies will be completed for tunnels on Tokha-Chahare, Shivpur- Bhaluwang, Ranighat-Bhurigaun, Dolalghat-Charnawati, and Hattisar-Babai.

title: A detailed study will be conducted to construct a standard-gauge electric railway along the East-West Highway in the upcoming year.
content: The under-construction Bardibas- Nijgadh Railway section will be built according to the standards of the East-West Electric Railway. The frozen land along the Kakarbhitta-Itahari section for acquisition to build the East-West Railway will be released.

title: A detailed project report for the Kathmandu-Kerung Railway will be prepared in the upcoming fiscal year.
content: Preparations will be advanced for the construction of railway lines connecting the southern border points New Jalpaiguri-Kakarbitta, Nautanwa- Bhairahawa, and Nepalgunj Road-Nepalgunj.

title: National road safety standards will be established to reduce human and physical losses caused by road crashes.
content: Arrangement of emergency services such as helicopters, specialized ambulances, trauma treatment will be made available for rapid rescue on major highways.

title: Inland water transport will be developed, expanded, and promoted based on feasibility.
content: Necessary preparations will be made to operate water transport along major rivers in Nepal, including the Koshi and Gandaki, up to the Kolkata port.

title: Construction of Nagdhunga, Siddhababa, and three tunnels on the Kathmandu-Terai Madhesh Fast-track will be completed in fiscal year 2025/26.
content: An additional 850 km of road will be blacktopped and 171 road bridges will be completed on national pride and major road projects.

title: I have allocated Rs.152 billion to the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport.
content: Planned Urban Development

title: The constitutional right of citizens to safe housing will be guaranteed.
content: Urban development will be linked with increased production, business expansion, and employment opportunities.

title: Land acquisition and financial access will be provided for collective housing development.
content: Policy facilitation will be done for community and joint housing developments constructed and operated by the private sector. Land consolidation and affordable housing development will be carried out based on feasibility.

title: Studies will be conducted to construct infrastructure in line with smart city and eco village.
content: Risk-prone and scattered settlements will be relocated to safe locations and developed into integrated settlements with adequate facilities. The original design of settlements and local architecture will be promoted. I have allocated budget for the preservation and infrastructure improvement of 50 settlements across the country.

title: Organized city will be developed in partnership with the private sector.
content: Land development projects will be implemented in the Ishan (North-east), Agnyea (South- east), Tarkeshwor, and Dukuchhap areas of the Kathmandu Valley.

title: The concept of utility corridors will be implemented to enhance the beauty and quality of basic services in the major cities including the Kathmandu Valley.
Construction work of the Jarsing Pauwa Stadium and Ganeshman Singh Park in Shankharapur, Kathmandu, and the Madan Bhandari Multipurpose Park in Budhanilkantha-Gokarneshwor will be commenced.
content: Bhanu Literature Park will be constructed in Chudi Ramgha, Tanahun. An international-standard exhibition hall will be built in Bhrikutimandap, Kathmandu.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 800 million to accelerate infrastructure development in the district headquarter of Nawalparasi East. I have allocated Rs. 1 billion to complete 129 administrative buildings under construction at the local levels.

title: The construction of the federal parliament and supreme court buildings will be completed in the upcoming year.
content: Reconstruction will be carried out for archaeologically important Shital Niwas, Harihar Bhawan, Shri Mahal, and the Gallery Meeting Hall.

title: Modern technology-based waste processing centers will be established to produce energy, fertilizer, briquettes, and other materials in partnership with the local levels and private sector.
Necessary infrastructure will be constructed to clean rivers in the Kathmandu Valley including Bagmati.
content: The corridor roads within the Kathmandu Valley will be gradually expanded. I have allocated Rs. 3.42 billion for this purpose.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 1.70 billion to advance the construction of new towns at ten key locations along the Mid-Hill Pushpalal Highway. I have allocated Rs. 5.36 billion under the Intensive Urban Development Program for urban infrastructure construction and upgradation across the country. Additionally, I have allocated Rs. 8.90 billion for the construction of local and suspension bridges.

title: The Town Development Fund will be restructured to enhance its investment capacity.
content: I have allocated Rs. 1.02 billion to continue the Terai-Madhesh Prosperity and Local Infrastructure Support Program.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 750 million for the construction of one thousand houses under the Janata Awas (Peoples’ Housing) Program and for replacing thatched roofs with safe roofs in five thousand houses under the Safe Citizen Housing.

title: Urban and rural roads of 727 km will be blacktopped and upgraded, construction of 46 local road bridges, and 200 suspension bridges will be completed in the fiscal year 2025/26.
I have allocated Rs.
content: 118.34 billion to the Ministry of Urban Development. Drinking Water and Sanitation

title: Clean and quality drinking water will be made available to all Nepali.
content: Drinking water supply systems will be sustainably managed in partnership with communities.

title: The drinking water supply system in the Kathmandu Valley will be integrated and managed.
content: Kathmandu Valley Water Supply Management Board, Kathmandu Upatyaka Khanepani Limited, Project Implementation Directorate, and Melamchi Water Supply Development Board will be integrated for this purpose.

title: In the context of drying up of traditional water sources due to the impacts of climate change, increasing urbanization, and excessive extraction of groundwater, programs such as reservoir-based drinking water projects, groundwater recharge, and revival of drinking water sources will be implemented.
Model projects will be implemented in seven cities of seven provinces to provide processed drinking water through cooperation of federation, provinces, local levels, and communities.
content: I have made arrangements to provide clean drinking water facilities to prisoners in jails.

title: Headworks of the Melamchi Water Supply Project will be reconstructed at a safe location considering disaster risks.
content: A new water treatment plant with a capacity of additional 255 million liters per day will be constructed at Sundarijal. The drinking water distribution network will be expanded in the Kathmandu Valley. I have allocated Rs. 6.37 billion for this purpose.

title: Construction of 280 incomplete drinking water projects in Terai-Madhesh will be completed and handed over to the local levels in the upcoming fiscal year.
content: Cooperation will be made with the province and local levels to implement the Ek Ghar Ek Dhara (One House, One Tap) Program effectively. Damaged water supply projects from disaster will be repaired and restored. I have allocated Rs. 410 million for this purpose.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 3.85 billion to build 184 projects under climate-adaptive drinking water projects. I have allocated Rs. 1.32 billion to complete the construction of the Bheri Pumping Drinking Water Project in Surkhet within upcoming two years. I have made a provision to provide 50 percent rebate on electricity tariffs for lift technology based drinking water supply services. I have allocated Rs. 1.09 billion for the construction and treatment of sewage systems in major cities.

title: Safe drinking water for 37 percent of the population will be available after completion of large-scale drinking water projects in fiscal year 2025/26.
content: This will ensure access to basic drinking water services for 98 percent of the population.

title: I have allocated Rs.
content: 33.89 billion to the Ministry of Water Supply. Post-Disaster Reconstruction

title: An early warning system for disasters will be developed to minimize losses.
content: Emphasis will be given on capacity building of personnel involved in disaster management and response, as well as in the adoption of safe technologies.

title: Private houses, schools, public infrastructure, archaeological and cultural heritage sites damaged by earthquakes and monsoon-related disasters will be reconstructed.
content: I have allocated Rs. 18.50 billion for this purpose. Economic Planning and Statistics

title: In accordance with the list of powers mentioned in the constitution, unbundling report, and project standards, an Integrated National Project Bank Management Information System will be implemented to avoid duplication of projects among the federal, provincial, and local levels.
content: Coordination and collaboration among the different levels of government will be promoted for the conservation and sustainable use of natural resources. Interlinkage will be established between the Project Bank, the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework, and the Line Ministry Budget Information System.

title: The National Economic Census, 2082 will be conducted.
content: The base year of national accounts will be updated. Statistical profiles of the federation, province, and local levels will be prepared. Big data processing capacity will be developed. The concept of open data will be implemented gradually. National Security, and Peace and Order

title: Nepal's sovereignty, territorial integrity, independence, freedom, and dignity will be safeguarded.
content: Social harmony and national unity will be strengthened.

title: Security agencies will be well equipped with adequate resources to make them strong, capable, and professional.
content: Necessary military supplies, arms, and security equipment will be provided for the security forces. The capacity of the Nepali Army will be enhanced and mobilized for national security, development activities, and disaster management. I have continued the Bunker to Barrack program.

title: Local administration will be strengthened to maintain peace, order, and security in the country.
content: Nepal Police will be empowered to ensure public safety and control crime. The Armed Police Force, Nepal, will be mobilized for border security, disaster management, and peacekeeping. The intelligence capacity of the National Investigation Department will be enhanced.

title: The immigration system will be upgraded by providing online payment system and online visa services facilities.
content: Residential visas will be provided free of charge to experts and investors working in startup businesses, and a Digital Nomad Visa will be made available to individuals residing in Nepal and working remotely for foreign companies.

title: The scope and effectiveness of the National Cadet Corps will be expanded and enhanced.
content: Awareness programs will be conducted in collaboration with communities to protect youth and children from drug abuse and addiction.

title: Physical infrastructure development, skill-based training, supportive environment for entrepreneurship, and psychosocial counseling will be provided for transforming prisons into rehabilitation centers.
content: The concept of open prisons will be gradually implemented. Physical infrastructure of prisons under construction will be developed and brought into operation. Foreign Relations

title: International relations will be maintained based on sovereign equality, mutual benefit, and respect.
content: Bilateral relations with neighboring countries will be strengthened on the basis of mutual interest and trust.

title: Foreign aid and investment, export, and tourism will be promoted through robust economic diplomacy.
content: Efforts will be taken forward to establish Nepal’s rights in sea- bed mining and benefit from it.

title: Effective diplomatic efforts will be made to protect the interests of Nepali citizens abroad.
content: Knowledge, skills, capital, technology, networks, and access of Non-Resident Nepali will be utilized for national development. Arrangements will be made for the timely rescue of Nepali facing crisis abroad. Lawful State and Human Rights

title: The constitution will be amended based on political consensus.
content: The Federal Democratic Republic will be further strengthened by increasing people's ownership and belongingness to the constitution. The rule of law, human rights, robust judicial administration, democratic values, and press freedom will be guaranteed.

title: The remaining work related to the peace process and transitional justice will be completed.
content: The Truth and Reconciliation Commission and the Commission of Investigation on Enforced Disappeared Persons will be made functional. Arrangements will be made for free treatment of injured, disabled, and incapacitated persons in government hospitals. I have allocated Rs. 1 billion to establish a fund for the investigation, relief, and compensation related to incidents of armed conflict.

title: The maximum information technology will be used to make the justice system simple, easy, accessible, prompt, and effective.
content: Free legal aid programs targeted at specific groups will be conducted to ensure equal access to justice for all. An electronic advocate program will be implemented to enhance the quality and capacity of advocacy in government plaintiff. Anti-Money Laundering

title: The national strategy and action plan for anti-money laundering and counter financing terrorism activities will be implemented to delist the country from the increased monitoring list before the scheduled time, and prevent such situations in the future.
The national risk assessment will be completed promptly, and the investigation and prosecution of serious economic crimes will be accelerated.
content: The monitoring, investigation, and enforcement capacities of regulatory bodies such as Nepal Rastra Bank, Securities Board, Nepal Insurance Authority, National Cooperatives Regulatory Authority will be enhanced to strengthen the anti-money laundering system. Strengthening the Financial Sector

title: The capacity of regulatory bodies in the financial sector will be strengthened.
content: Necessary arrangements will be made to facilitate capital flow and access to credit. Corporate governance will be maintained by strengthening financial sector risk management. Necessary policy and legal provisions will be made to introduce newly developed risk mitigation instruments in the financial sector.

title: Timely reforms will be made to the laws related to the Nepal Rastra Bank and the Nepal Insurance Authority.
content: Institutional capacity of the Securities Board will be strengthened to protect citizens' investments and interests in the capital market. Institutional capacity of Nepal Stock Exchange will be strengthened by restructuring it.

title: The Second Financial Sector Reform Strategy will be implemented.
content: An Asset Management Company will be established to manage non-performing loans and non- banking assets of banks and financial institutions.

title: Facilitation will be provided to support the revival of businesses affected by contraction of business due to decrease in aggregate demand, through loan rescheduling, additional working capital flow, and concessions on interest and penalties.
Arrangements will be made to fill in KYC details once a year at one place by concerned individual and it will be linked to the national identity card.
content: Arrangements will be made for digital access to institutions requiring KYC details.

title: Credit flow to the private sector will be expanded to make the economy dynamic.
content: The existing sectoral risk regime will be reviewed and credit flow for working capital will be facilitated.

title: Neo Bank will be established within the fiscal year 2025/26.
content: Rural economy will be developed by increasing access to bank and financial institutions in these areas. Digital, mobile, and branchless banking services will be expanded.

title: The scope of property insurance will be expanded to protect against losses caused by natural calamities, disasters, and accidents.
content: Insurance companies will be directed to expand their access to the rural areas. Cyber security insurance service will be operated. Reinsurance arrangements will be made for managing the potential risks of the Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund.

title: Policy and structural arrangements will be made to mobilize private capital through green and sustainable development bonds, aligned with the concept of green taxonomy.
content: Capital will be attracted from international markets by issuing local currency-linked bonds.

title: Investment companies listed in the securities market, and other institutional investors will be facilitated to invest in equity, bonds, and other securities of nationally prioritized industries.
content: Legal provisions will be made to enable the Employees Provident Fund, Citizen Investment Trust, and Social Security Fund to invest in private equity and venture capital.

title: Secondary market trading of government bonds will be started.
content: Arrangements will be made to allow Non-Resident Nepali to trade in the secondary market.

title: An integrated system for interest subsidy on concessional loans will be implemented to increase production, employment, and self-employment opportunities in targeted areas.
Institutional and internal control systems of microfinance institutions will be reformed.
content: Provision of loans at concessional interest rates will be facilitated for the rehabilitation of problematic microfinance borrowers.

title: Arrangements will be made to allow the operation of hedging services to attract foreign investment by managing foreign exchange risk.
A law related to credit transactions will be formulated.
content: Insolvency Act will be timely amended. Remittance inflow from banking channel and its investment in productive sector will be encouraged. All payments made by public entities will be linked to electronic system.

title: Arrangements will be made to confiscate and deposit criminal assets such as intangible currencies like crypto and illegal foreign currencies into the consolidated fund.
content: The process to freeze, control, and confiscate criminal assets will be made more effective. Public Enterprises Management

title: Competitiveness of public enterprises will be developed through management autonomy, technology transfer, and innovation.
content: Appropriate methods such as restructuring, transformation into company, strategic partnership, and divestment will be adopted to improve the management of the public enterprises. A policy to retain land ownership under the Government of Nepal will be adopted while managing government investments of public enterprises.

title: Closed and sick industries under the ownership of the Government of Nepal will be operated and managed by utilizing modern technology on the basis of appropriateness.
content: The Dhaubadi Iron Company will be operated under Public-Private Partnership.

title: The government investments will be managed by studying the current status and commercial feasibility of public enterprises including the Janakpur Cigarette Factory, Gorakhkali Rubber Industry, Butwal Yarn Factory, Nepal Metal Company, Nepal Orind and Magnesite, and Hetauda and Udayapur Cement Industries.
Thirty percent of the shares of the Nepal Telecom Company will be divested to the general public while maintaining the majority shareholding to the Government of Nepal.
content: Policy of strategic partnership will be adopted for institutional strengthening of this company.

title: The regulatory capacity of the Nepal Electricity Authority will be enhanced.
content: A robust institutional arrangement will be established to separate the roles of electricity generation, transmission, and distribution.

title: Transforming the Nepal Airlines Corporation into public company, implementing management contracts and strategic partnerships with competent international airlines will be carried out to enhance its capacity, improve quality, and promote professionalism.
content: The Dairy Development Corporation will be restructured. Institutional reforms of Rastriya Beema Company and the Rastriya Jeewan Beema Company will be made.

title: I have made arrangement to restrict -
content: officials and employees of public enterprises that are unable to cover operational expenses, have not provisioned retirement funds, and are unable to audit up to previous fiscal year - undertaking foreign trips at the institutions’ expense and increasing financial liabilities by expanding service benefits. Governance Reform and Corruption Control

title: The unbundling report on functional division of powers among federation, province, and local levels, as enshrined in the constitution, will be reviewed.
content: Reforms will be made in prevailing laws to ensure functional alignment and uniformity in laws of all three levels. Policy, legal, and institutional reforms will be carried out under the guidance of the High-Level Governance Reform Commission.

title: The Federal Civil Service Bill will be passed during the current parliamentary session.
content: I believe this will establish uniformity in service conditions of civil servants and ensure their career development.

title: The Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers will be developed as a Centre of Excellence to enhance public service effectiveness and make development result-
content: oriented.

title: Interoperability will be maintained among the existing information technology systems in public service.
content: Capacity of the Nagarik App will be expanded. Public service will be made simple, accessible, and cost-effective by integrating it into the Nagarik App. Arrangement will be made to securely store all government electronic data under a unified system.

title: Optimum utilization of information technology will be done to make public service delivery simple, accessible and of high quality.
content: The National Identity Card will be used in all forms of public and financial transactions, including banking, insurance, telecommunications, securities. Arrangement will made to waive fee while using services of National Identity Card Service Management System. Distribution of citizenship certificates through electronic means will be made effective.

title: Although the need to update the benefits of public servants in a timely manner is well recognized, it has not been possible to increase salaries as expected due to pressure on resource management.
content: Nevertheless, I have raised the monthly dearness allowance to Rs. 5 thousand for all public servants, effective from 1st Shrawan 2082 (mid-July 2025).

title: Sulav Awas Karyakram (Affordable Housing Program) will be implemented through the initiatives of the retirement funds including Employees Provident Fund and participation from the private sector.
content: I have made arrangement to construct 100 thousand buildings and apartments in major urban centers of all seven provinces, and make it available to civil servants, security personnel, and teachers at concessional interest rates and installment under this initiative.

title: The Civil Service Hospital will be upgraded.
content: The health care facilities currently being provided by the Employees Provident Fund to contributors and their spouses will be expanded to other family members as well.

title: Employees in the contract service within approved positions, as well as temporary and relief teachers, will be included in the contribution based social security scheme.
content: Separate package with ten percent contribution from both employer and contributor will be developed and implemented for this purpose.

title: All constitutional bodies will be provided with necessary means, resources, and human resource.
content: Transparency, accountability, and integrity will be maintained in performance of public institutions. Codes of conduct on professional ethics and discipline will be developed and implemented in public institutions. Continuous monitoring and supervision will be carried out in public institutions. Zero-tolerance against corruption will be adopted. Law on conflict of interest will be formulated. The second national strategy and action plan against corruption will be implemented.

title: The Voter Identity Card will be integrated with the National Identity Card to enhance the credibility of elections.
content: This initiative will be launched from the Kathmandu Valley. Foreign Aid Mobilization

title: In accordance with the Foreign Aid Mobilization Policy, 2025, assistance will be mobilized in projects that yield high returns in line with national needs and priorities.
content: The country's leadership and ownership will be established in selection and implementation of projects. The capacity to utilize foreign aid will be enhanced.

title: Assistance will be received in projects and programs that have completed preparation as per the project readiness filter.
content: Implementation framework will be finalized to complete the project within the stipulated time and cost.

title: Arrangements will be made to grant approval for the use of forest areas considering the projects implemented with foreign assistance as national priority projects.
content: I expect this to speed up the implementation of projects.

title: Assistance will be mobilized through co-investment from more than one donor agency for high-cost infrastructure projects including Dudhkoshi and Upper Arun based on economic feasibility.
content: Public Finance and Project Management

title: The effectiveness of public finance will be increased by maintaining allocative efficiency.
content: The outcomes of public expenditure will be increased through budget discipline. Cash flow management will be strengthened to balance the federal consolidated fund. Productive utilization and sustainability of public debt will be ensured. The national financial management reform strategy will be implemented.

title: It has become indispensable to adopt innovative and successful practices of the international community to meet the need for development finance.
content: Alternative Development Finance Bill has already been presented in the federal parliament to establish a legal framework for this purpose. I believe that this bill will be passed from the current session. I believe that this will attract both domestic and foreign private investment in the construction and operation of infrastructure projects of hydropower, solar energy, transmission lines, roads, tunnels, airports, urban infrastructure, tourism, and industrial infrastructure, foster long-term capital formation, and bring about qualitative changes in project construction and management. Construction of infrastructure projects will be commenced through alternative development finance in the upcoming fiscal year.

title: Clear criteria will be developed for the selection of national pride projects.
content: Existing national pride projects will be reviewed.

title: I have streamlined project management through the reduction of number of development projects by 4,654 compared to the previous year.
content: I have implemented a standard under which the federal government will not allocate less than Rs. 30 million to any new infrastructure project it undertakes. I have expected that this will help in resource management for national pride and priority projects and effectiveness of project implementation. The line ministries will be made more responsible to increase capital expenditure by improving budget execution capacity.

title: Arrangements will be made to move projects into the procurement process that have completed preparations, such as land acquisition, forest area approval.
content: Provisions will be made in the contract agreement to conduct the work in three shifts for accelerating project implementation.

title: The public procurement law will be amended to complete infrastructure projects within the specified time, projected cost, and quality.
content: The electronic procurement system will be upgraded. Sample bid documents related to public procurement will be developed, revised, and localized in Nepali language. Project managers and contractors will be made more accountable towards the result. Arrangements will be made to include all project-related works in a single contract package. Mediation process will be made legally compliant, transparent, and accountable for resolving disputes during the implementation of contract agreement.

title: I have made arrangements for the province and local levels to formulate balanced budgets and manage multi-year liabilities within the limits of the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework.

I have made arrangements so that the procurement preparations for the programs and projects included in the budget can begin from today itself and agreements can be signed within the current fiscal year after the budget is approved.

From the upcoming fiscal year, I have made arrangement to prohibit the virement of funds allocated for national pride and high-priority projects to other projects or programs, except in special circumstances.
content: National dashboard system will be developed to monitor goal progress, quality, and timeframe for projects costing more than Rs. 250 million.

title: The concerned officials will be held accountable if the cost increases due to not taking decisions on time during project implementation.
content: For projects with more than 80 percent progress, their completion will not be hindered due to shortage of resources.

title: Emphasis will be given on achieving development results by completing the ongoing projects.
content: I have allocated necessary funds for multi-year projects with assured resources and for the payment of liabilities incurred.

title: Individuals who create unnatural liabilities by preparing faulty designs and specifications will be held accountable and brought under the purview of the law.
content: Regional and local roads, other than national highways, will be constructed with intermediate lanes in hilly and mountainous areas. Cost-effectiveness

title: Laws will be developed to strengthen budget discipline as specified in the constitution at the federation, province, and local levels.
content: Public expenditure standards applicable to all three levels will be formulated.

title: A national subsidy policy based on production incentives to be applicable at all three levels will be formulated to ensure that subsidies provided from government funds reach the targeted groups and avoid duplication.
content: The maximum limit of subsidies will be fixed at 50 percent of the cost.

title: The existing structure and position will be reviewed by formulating national standards for organization and management surveys in line with the functions of the federal, provincial and local levels.
content: Significant reductions will be made in recurrent expenses through lean and functional structure, and personnel management.
