title: The salaries and benefits of the officials and employees of institutions, boards, committees, and public bodies receiving facilities from the state treasury will be reviewed and made uniform.
content: For this purpose, a recommendation committee will be formed to submit a report with suggestions within three months.

title: I have made arrangements for citizens who have completed 70 years of age to receive senior citizen allowance from the upcoming fiscal year taking into account the report of the High-Level Economic Reforms and Suggestions Commission.
content: I have kept the age requirement unchanged for the senior citizens in remote areas and targeted groups who are currently receiving the allowance.

title: An umbrella law will be formulated to maintain uniformity in the operation and management of all Academies across the country.
content: I have made arrangements for the Academies and development committees to operate and manage their liabilities within the limits of the current and capital grants available from the federal government.

title: Foreign travel will not be undertaken at the expense of the Government of Nepal, except for high-level diplomatic visits, and mandatory representation in international organizations of which Nepal is a member.
I have made arrangements that unless the responsible officials decide that the task cannot be completed through the regular structure, the consultancy services will not be used.
content: Consultancy services will not be utilized for supervision, except for large and complex projects. I have made arrangements to prohibit consultancy services for drafting the documents such as laws, rules, policies, procedures, standards.

title: Implementation arrangement will be made in construction works so that the contingency fund limit will be reduced up to 3 percent for projects with a cost estimate of up to Rs.
content: 1 billion, and up to 2 percent for projects exceeding that amount. Right Honourable Speaker, Right Honourable Chairperson Now, please allow me to present the budget allocation and resource management estimates for the implementation of the aforementioned sectoral policies and programs.

title: I have allocated total expenditure of Rs.
content: 1,964.11 billion for the upcoming fiscal year. Out of the total allocation, Rs. 1,180.98 billion, i.e., 60.1 percent, is allocated for recurrent expenditure, Rs. 407.89 billion, i.e., 20.8 percent, is for capital expenditure, and Rs. 375.24 billion, i.e., 19.1 percent, is for financing. This estimation is 5.6 percent higher than the current fiscal year's allocation and 18.2 percent higher than the revised estimates. Out of the total allocation, I have allocated Rs. 417.83 billion for fiscal transfers to province and local levels.

title: Of the total estimated financing sources for the upcoming fiscal year, Rs.
content: 1,315 billion will be financed through revenue mobilization and Rs. 53.45 billion from foreign grants, resulting a deficit of Rs. 595.66 billion. To cover this deficit, Rs. 233.66 billion will be raised from foreign loans. The net remaining amount of Rs. 362 billion after revenue and foreign aid mobilization will be financed from domestic borrowings. Right Honourable Speaker, Right Honourable Chairperson Now, please allow me to present the revenue policy and programs for the fiscal year 2025/26.

title: It is necessary to make the revenue system investment-friendly and production-oriented and to manage resources for the ever-increasing public expenditure.
content: It is necessary to attract foreign capital and technology by making the tax system compatible with international standards and practices. It is necessary to make revenue collection effective by improving tax compliance and controlling revenue leakage. Therefore, I have set the following objectives for the upcoming fiscal year to increase the productivity of the revenue system. (a) To broaden the tax base by encouraging economic activity, (b) To increase voluntary tax compliance by timely reform and simplification of tax laws, (c) To develop taxpayer-friendly, transparent, and automated revenue system, (d) To control revenue leakage by enhancing the efficiency of revenue administration, (e) To mobilize non-tax revenue while making the use of natural resources sustainable and cost-effective. Now, I present the programs related to revenue for the fiscal year 2025/26. Timely Reforms in Tax Laws

title: Laws related to Value Added Tax, Income Tax, and Excise Duty will be reviewed to address changes in the tax system and new business models at the international level.
A study will be conducted on relevance, and practical application of multiple rates of Value Added Tax, also considering the suggestions received for it.
The rates of non-tax revenue will be updated by amending the sectoral laws.
content: Industrial Protection and Investment Promotion

title: I have made arrangements to provide income tax and electricity tariff exemption equivalent to special industries to information technology-based industries, and hotels and resorts.
I have made arrangements for 75 percent tax exemption on income received from the export of information technology services.
content: I have made arrangements for only 5 percent income tax to be levied on the income of individuals residing in Nepal and exporting information technology services abroad and this tax will be final.

title: I have made arrangements to exempt startup business with annual turnover of up to Rs.
content: 100 million from income tax for 5 years.

title: I have levied only 1 percent customs duty on the import of mill machinery required for wood seasoning industry and abolished other taxes and duties to increase the quality production and consumption of wood and wood-based materials.
I have removed customs duties and abolished other taxes and duties on the import of mill machinery and equipment for the production of organic and natural fertilizers.
I have levied 1 percent customs duty on the import of machinery, equipment, and sports materials required for the construction of infrastructure for football, cricket, and multi-
content: purpose stadiums and abolished other taxes and duties.

title: I have made arrangements to exempt all types of taxes and duties on machinery equipment to be imported for the green hydrogen producing industry.
content: I have made arrangements to provide income tax exemption to green hydrogen producers for 5 years.

title: I have made arrangements to levy 1 percent customs duty and exempt other taxes and duties on the import of batteries and other machinery equipment required to store electricity from solar and wind energy.

I have made arrangement to levy 1 percent customs duty and exempt other taxes and duties on the import of equipment required to establish industries for manufacturing and assembling electric vehicle charging machines.
content: In addition, I have made arrangements to provide income tax exemption to such industries for 5 years.

title: For the purpose of writing off the registration of public and private vehicles that are more than twenty years old or are no longer in operation, I have made arrangements to provide tax exemption on the remaining income tax if the income tax for the last two years is paid.

I have made arrangements to levy 1 percent customs duty and exempt the remaining taxes and duties while importing tunnel boring machines by the private sector to promote the use of tunneling technology in road, irrigation, and hydropower projects.

I have made arrangements allowing freight service providers to deduct the amount paid as fare for means of transportation owned by a natural person, on which advance tax has been withheld when calculating taxable income.

I have made a provision requiring mandatory affiliation of retirement funds previously approved by the Inland Revenue Department with retirement funds operated by the Employees Provident Fund, Citizen Investment Trust, Social Security Fund, or Pension Fund.

I have provided concessions on interest, additional fees, late fees, and penalties to those who have failed to submit their Value Added Tax and Excise Duty returns or to pay taxes if they submit their returns and taxes.

I have made arrangement to waive interest, additional fees, and penalties if international aviation service providers and their air ticket sellers register for Value Added Tax and pay the outstanding tax amount.
I have given an opportunity to taxpayers who have not submitted their income tax returns to settle the arrears created by the amended tax assessment done by the office.
I have abolished the Value-Added Tax levied on clearing house services to encourage digital payments.
I have abolished the advance income tax being levied at customs points on plants such as food grains, beans, fruits, as well as animal and dairy products.
I have abolished the Value-Added Tax on hearing aids required for people with hearing impairment.

Facilitation will be made for the provision to allow passengers entering Nepal by air or land to bring in up to US dollar 5 thousand or equivalent in travelers’ cheque and other foreign currency for exchange within Nepal; any amount exceeding this limit must be declared at the customs checkpoint.
I have removed the existing price limit of Rs.
content: 1.6 million on ambulances carrying patients that can be imported under the revenue exemption facility.

title: To reduce environment pollution by encouraging the use of electric vehicles and to increase domestic consumption of electricity, I have maintained all taxes and duties levied on such vehicles as it is.
content: Broadening of the Tax Scope and Base Protection

title: I have increased the customs duty rate on the import of alcohol, beer, tobacco, and cigarettes.
content: I have adjusted some of the customs duty rates. I have made a modest increase in the existing excise duty rate. I have expanded the scope of the health risk tax.

title: The scope of the central billing monitoring system will be expanded while increasing taxpayer participation in the electronic billing system.
Voluntary tax participation will be enhanced through taxpayer education and compliance with the law.
I have expanded the scope of the Digital Service Tax to bring all types of digital transactions under the purview of taxation.
The tax expenditure system will be made rational by timely revision of tax exemptions, concessions, and facilities.
content: Trade Facilitation and Improvement in Service Delivery

title: I have made a provision that prohibits the collection of entry fees, route charges, or any other duties by the federation, province, or local levels on temporary imported vehicles, means of transportation, and equipment after customs duties have been collected at the customs points while transporting within Nepal.
I have abolished the provision of bank guarantee of Rs.
content: 300 thousand to be provided by industrialists and businessmen engaged in export and import while obtaining EXIM code.

title: I have repealed the existing provision that requires the taxpayers to pay minimum tax even if they have not made any taxable transactions.
Authorized Economic Operators will be selected, and such individuals will be provided with fast-track clearance facilities and on-site inspection services for goods during import and export.
To make customs valuation more realistic, an automated database of international price trends will be developed, and the reference value will be replaced by an automated valuation system.
content: Control of Revenue leakage

title: The risk of revenue leakage will be reduced by developing a system for exchanging data and information related to bilateral trade with neighboring countries.
An intelligence-based investigation system will be developed to control revenue leakage.
content: Information exchange and joint monitoring among agencies involved in revenue mobilization will be made effective. Increasing Efficiency in Revenue Administration

title: The revenue service will be gradually transformed into paperless, contactless, and faceless system by specializing, and enhancing the capacity and efficiency of revenue administration.
Integrated check points will be established and upgraded at major custom points to facilitate trade and reduce business costs.
Business Process Reengineering will be carried out to make timely changes in the inland revenue information system.
content: I believe that this will simplify the work process and tax compliance, and reduce collection cost.

title: Reforms as per the Domestic Revenue Mobilization Strategy and the Customs Reform and Modernization Action Plan will be accelerated.
Foreign trade will be facilitated by expanding the scope of the national single window information system.
content: Right Honourable Speaker, Right Honourable Chairperson

title: I have presented the actual expenditure for last fiscal year 2023/24, the revised estimate for current fiscal year 2024/25, and the expenditure estimate along with heading wise sources for the upcoming fiscal year 2025/26.
content: I have presented the estimated income- expenditure details in the annexes. I have also presented the statement on technical assistance to be received from international development partners, and assistance to be mobilized from international non-governmental organizations.

title: I expect that economic reforms will be paced and a conducive environment will be created to achieve high and sustainable economic growth from the execution of the proposed budget.
content: I believe that this budget will make significant contributions toward increasing private investment, expanding economic activities, developing entrepreneurship, and generating employment opportunities by diversifying the economy. I am confident that this budget will help to strengthen revenue mobilization, maintain budget discipline, and focus government investment on high-return sectors. I believe this will bring dynamism in the economy and acceleration in development.

title: I have estimated to achieve an economic growth of 6 percent in the upcoming fiscal year through the implementation of policies and programs proposed in the budget.
content: It is estimated that inflation will remain within the limit of 5.5 percent in the upcoming year. Monetary policy will be issued by Nepal Rastra Bank to support the implementation of policies and programs mentioned in the budget.

title: I express my profound gratitude to the Right Honourable President, Right Honourable Vice President, Right Honourable Prime Minister, Right Honourable Chief Justice, Right Honourable Speaker, Right Honourable Chairperson, and senior leaders of political parties who guided in formulating the budget.
content: I express my sincere thanks to all including Honourable Ministers, Honourable Members of the Federal Parliament, political parties, private sector, development partners, experts from various fields, media, public servants, and civil society for providing suggestions on the budget. I expect constructive support from all concerned in the implementation of the proposed budget. Thank You! Disclaimer: If the content in English and Nepali version of this budget contradicts, the latter will be valid.
